title: The Language of Laws and Notices

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *todo aquel que desee* and the formal register of notices from B2 Unit 14: *Todo aquel que desee participar deberá llenar el formulario*. It is a set of habits you already know: *se* for rules (B1 Unit 6), the future for what people must do (A2 Unit 19) and *todo aquel que* with the subjunctive. Law 70 of 1993 and the notices of community councils are written this way.

sections.title: Everyday and formal
rows: Si quieres participar, tienes que llenar el formulario.
Todo aquel que desee participar deberá llenar el formulario. (Anyone who wishes to take part must fill in the form.)
Las tierras colectivas no podrán venderse. (The collective lands may not be sold.)
Antes de hacer una obra, hay que preguntar a la comunidad.
Todo proyecto que afecte un territorio colectivo deberá consultarse con la comunidad. (Any project that affects a collective territory must be discussed with the community.)
Estimados miembros del consejo comunitario: (Dear members of the community council:)

sections.title: Where you meet it
sections.content: Laws, official letters and the notices of a community council use this register. When you read the Spanish of a law, look for the future (*podrán*, *deberán*), *se* (*no podrán venderse*) and the open "anyone who" with the subjunctive.

items.spanish: Todo aquel que desee participar deberá llenar el formulario.
items.english: Anyone who wishes to take part must fill in the form.

items.spanish: Las tierras colectivas no podrán venderse.
items.english: The collective lands may not be sold.

items.spanish: Cualquier persona que llegue tarde no podrá entrar.
items.english: Anyone who arrives late will not be able to come in.

items.spanish: Se ruega a los miembros de la comunidad llegar a las nueve.
items.english: Members of the community are kindly asked to arrive at nine.

sections.content: Formal does not mean difficult: it means impersonal and polite. A law speaks about "anyone who" and "the communities", not about "you". Do not mix registers: *Todo aquel que desee entrar debes mostrar tu boleto* is wrong, because *todo aquel* needs *deberá* and *su*.
